refused_program.intent: Bring the current branch up to date with the upstream remote by merging it, and when a file changed on both sides conflicts, resolve it by keeping the local content (so locally removed lines stay removed) while inserting the lines upstream added, then commit the merge.

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit with two parents
postconditions.name: merge_commit_created

postconditions.description: the upstream tip is contained in HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: no conflicted paths remain in the index
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: the resolution is committed and nothing is left dirty
postconditions.name: worktree_clean

postconditions.description: for every path both sides changed, no line upstream inserted is missing from the merged file and no line local deleted reappears
postconditions.name: keeps_local_removals_and_upstream_additions
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2) || exit 1
fail=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  present=$(git show "HEAD:$f" 2>/dev/null | sort -u)
  added=$(git diff "$base" HEAD^2 -- "$f" | awk '/^@@/{h=1;next} h && /^\+/{print substr($0,2)}' | sort -u)
  removed=$(git diff "$base" HEAD^1 -- "$f" | awk '/^@@/{h=1;next} h && /^-/{print substr($0,2)}' | sort -u)
  if [ -n "$added" ] && [ -n "$(comm -23 <(printf '%s\n' "$added") <(printf '%s\n' "$present"))" ]; then
    fail=1
  fi
  if [ -n "$removed" ] && [ -n "$(comm -12 <(printf '%s\n' "$removed") <(printf '%s\n' "$present"))" ]; then
    fail=1
  fi
done < <(comm -12 <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^2 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u))
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch is present locally
preconditions.name: upstream_tracking_ref_exists

preconditions.description: the tree is clean, or a merge with unresolved paths is already in progress
preconditions.name: worktree_ready
preconditions.probe:
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  [ -n "$(git ls-files -u)" ]
else
  [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]
fi

preconditions.description: HEAD and upstream each carry commits the other lacks (no fast-forward is possible)
preconditions.name: branches_diverged
preconditions.probe:
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 0
fi
ahead=$(git rev-list --count {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}..HEAD)
behind=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})
[ "$ahead" -gt 0 ] && [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]

preconditions.description: at least one path was changed on both sides relative to the merge base, so the merge can collide
preconditions.name: shared_changed_path
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
| grep -q .
